name: polaris_kernel_submit_user_input
logic_name: Offline typed user message recording (SubmitUserInput -> Event::UserInputSubmitted)

test_list.description: Event::UserInputSubmitted serializes with the snake_case tag, round-trips, and is rejected below schema 7 (polaris-sdk event_envelope).
The event-log codec stores and decodes the new variant with its schema prefix (polaris-eventlog event_codec).
Protobuf conversion preserves the Cid of UserInputSubmitted (polaris-proto event_conversion, including the proptest strategy and the variant tag table).
Telemetry aggregation treats the event as a no-op for token, cost and tool counters.
The ui-model reducer leaves counters untouched and does not push text; frontends push resolved text.
The local-control verifier authorizes SubmitUserInput with the same credential, frame check and evidence digest as ApplyDirective.
ProposeDiff and every other non-control body, and a wrong frame, remain rejected.
Plain prose submitted through KernelHandle::submit_user_input commits UserInputSubmitted whose Cid resolves to the exact text in CAS.
Whitespace-only input is rejected as 'user input is empty' and appends no event.
Input above MAX_CONTROL_BYTES is rejected before CAS write.
A non-UTF-8 CAS blob submitted with a valid credential is rejected as 'user input is not UTF-8' and appends no event.
A CAS blob over MAX_CONTROL_BYTES submitted with a valid credential is rejected as 'user input exceeds limit'.
After shutdown and a new kernel on the same root, the replayed log still contains the UserInputSubmitted record with the same text.
ApplyDirective still requires exactly one directive and keeps its error strings (existing local_runtime tests).
submit_user_input after shutdown fails with a closed error.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Bounded, non-blank UTF-8 user message stored verbatim (no directive parsing).

output_description: Receipt for the committed UserInputSubmitted record; no model execution is implied.
